text:
Mia: heads up — after the webinar blitz ~3.8% of HubSpot leads are stuck with enrichment_status=pending and never move into RR.
Sam: that explains the missed followups. do we see webhook failures?
Mia: enrich-bot shows several 504s from 16:02-16:10 UTC, retry window exhausted.
enrich-bot: automated note: 9 enrichment callbacks failed (504) between 16:02-16:10 UTC; retries exhausted.
Lee: enrichment service acknowledged a brief surge and backpressure. callbacks retried but HS didn't update contact property.
Ashley: CS flagged a few VIPs that sat unassigned. can we fallback after a short wait?
Raj: we should. propose: if enrichment_pending > 5m then route to fallback SDR queue with property enrich_fallback=true and tag "needs-enrich".
Sam: easy patch in HS workflow UI: change hold condition to fallback when enrichment_started_at < now() - 5m. i'll push at 18:00 UTC.
Raj: guard it — only apply fallback for inbound.source in (webinar/*, api/*) to avoid misrouting high-touch MQLs.
Mia: add a Datadog monitor for fallback_rate > 1% over 15m so ops get alerted before CS volume spikes.
Lee: on it — will create monitor on HubSpot contact property change events, and post to #marketing if threshold breached.
Ashley: i'll draft an SDR blurb explaining "needs-enrich": what to check and a one-liner for outreach.
Sam: rollout plan: 1) workflow fallback at 5m (today), 2) add enrich_retry_count prop (tomorrow), 3) implement idempotent callback shim and retry shim (next sprint).
Mia: can someone open a ticket and link the HS workflow id?
Raj: created RDW-1428 and linked HS workflow 98123. assigning to @sam and @lee.
Sam: finished — workflow patched and smoke-tested. fallback window=5m, tag=needs-enrich. posted patch notes to the change log.
Mia: verified test leads moved to fallback owner; CS could follow up. monitoring enabled.
Lee: Datadog monitor created and Slack alert wired.
Ashley: shared SDR note in #marketing-desk. short script included.
Raj: keeping RDW-1428 open until shim is shipped. mark this thread for postmortem once callback fix lands. :thumbsup:
